items.title: Nasa’s Voyager 1 to reach one light-day from Earth today; why it's important
items.author: PRANJAL PANDEY
items.description: Nasa's Voyager 1 spacecraft will shortly reach a distance of approximately 25.9 billion kilometers from Earth. This milestone, known as one light-day, means that signals will take 24 hours to travel to and from the spacecraft. Voyager 1 was launched in 1977 to study the outer planets, and it has been sending data back to Earth.

items.title: Sebi revises margin requirements for commodity derivatives
items.description: The Securities and Exchange Board of India has introduced new guidelines for commodity derivatives, establishing a minimum initial margin of 6%, 8%, and 10% based on commodity volatility. The risk margin timeline is confined to two days for low and medium volatility, while high volatility spans three days. This regulatory update will impact both agricultural and non-agricultural commodities and is set to be implemented by December 1, 2026.

items.title: Man buys flat with wife, faces Rs 14.25L addition for on-money claim; what ITAT said
items.author: TOI BUSINESS DESK
items.description: The dispute involved a man who purchased a flat in Thane, jointly with his wife for Rs 72 lakh. The property was registered in April 2012. The man filed his income tax return for assessment year 2012-13, declaring income of Rs 2,71,280. The return was initially accepted, but the assessment was subsequently reopened after the department received information concerning alleged cash payments to the real estate developer from whom the flat had been bought.

items.title: MS Dhoni's IPL legacy: 12 records that may never be broken
items.author: PRANAV SHUKLA
items.description: Mahendra Singh Dhoni concludes his playing career in the Indian Premier League after 18 seasons. He has left a legacy marked by numerous records and unforgettable moments in the tournament. Dhoni is renowned for his finishing skills and captained CSK to five IPL titles. He holds records for the most matches and runs scored as a wicketkeeper in IPL history.

items.title: Gurugram teen's AI helps blind people read PDFs; flags 2,221 bank-site barriers
items.author: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK
items.description: Yash Bhatnagar created Visionably, an AI tool that improves PDF accessibility for visually impaired individuals. His journey began with programming at a young age, leading to innovative projects for different needs. Through Visionably, he identified over 2,200 accessibility barriers in banking websites across India. Yash collaborates with various organizations to enhance document and website accessibility. His ultimate aim is to integrate accessibility into the design process for everyone.
